name: shape-it
description: Plan a piece of work by reading the project first, saying in plain words what it is and what skipping it costs, then asking only what is expensive to reverse. Asks nothing when nothing passes the bar, goes straight from the answers to the plan, writes it to a file — or onto the ticket where the repo's instructions keep plans in a tracker — prints it in full, and ends with one question: implement here, open it in Plannotator, or hand it to land-it. `shape-it` reads and writes the project's DOMAIN.md and docs/decisions/ so answers outlive the plan; `shape-it-lite` is the same procedure without them, for repos that carry neither or cannot. Ships `domain` and the manual-only `domain-adopt` for maintaining the model itself; adoption ends with a blast-radius-sorted list of everything the new model made wrong.
